title: Treasury will not commit to reducing welfare bill before next election
description: The Treasury is disputing that the chancellor suggested to the BBC the benefits bill will be cut before the next election.

title: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
description: The recordings appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move even though another up ahead had stalled.

title: Russell Brand's wife tells his rape trial he is 'kind and a wonderful father'
description: Laura Brand tells the jury at his trial she feels "very seen by him" and "I love him very much".

title: Serious pollution by water industry remains high despite £5bn investment
description: All but one of England's water companies were rated as "poor" or "requiring improvement" for environmental targets.

title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

title: Poundland's future hangs in the balance as chain edges towards collapse
description: Poundland's bosses is filing a notice of intention to appoint administrators to the business.

title: Bereaved families appalled by footage of Seoul crush in Call of Duty
description: Modern Warfare 4 uses video from the Itaewon crush to show the aftermath of an imagined North Korean attack.

title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
description: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.
